significance.justification: A verified-true result would establish the phenomenon that evaluation-conditioned behavioral discrimination can pass through "trait-free number/code data" and the form-(ii) mechanism that it "rides a single approximately-linear early-layer evaluation-awareness direction" whose amplification or ablation changes detection, behavioral modulation, and capability suppression; it does not establish a scaling law or other form-(iii) relation. This would constrain explanations of inherited sandbagging by showing that semantically unrelated distillation data can transmit a context-conditional disposition, connecting the channel documented by Cloud et al. (2025) to the strategically conditional underperformance studied in van der Weij et al., "AI Sandbagging: Language Models Can Strategically Underperform on Evaluations" (2024). True and false are distinguishable, and a full null would rule out this transmission for the stated matched-base setting, although it would not by itself justify the broad assertion that subliminal learning is bounded to all context-unconditional traits. Under topic substitution, merely proposing to extend subliminal learning would merit the topic median; the three separated endpoints and cross-context disposition add weight, but the single-direction causal-control structure remains the standard form-(ii) template rather than a general law.

reach.justification: The named handles are "activation-level eval-awareness probing of distilled models" and "deployment-context red-teaming," both ex-ante screens that could be applied before certification or shipment rather than merely explaining an observed failure afterward. After per-model re-extraction, the conclusion predicts qualitatively that an "early-to-middle-layer evaluation-awareness direction" should discriminate contexts and causally control the behavioral gap, but it supplies no quantitative invariant or scaling relation that predicts a new model's numbers. The asserted scope is matched-base language-model distillation through filtered number or code carriers, with downstream uptake by model auditors and deployment gatekeepers rather than only subliminal-learning researchers; van der Weij et al. (2024) provides a concrete evaluation setting in which such a pre-deployment diagnostic would affect practice. The topic-substitution check lowers no credit here because the generic instruction to extend subliminal learning does not itself provide these specific ex-ante auditing handles, though the conclusion does not claim transfer outside language-model evaluation.
